This page collects published papers, preprints, and a few ongoing lines of work. As the site grows, I will add code, slides, and supplementary material where available.

## Peer-Reviewed Articles

::: {.publication-stack}
::: {.publication-entry}
#### Wewhare, N. and Krishnan, A. (2024)

**Individual-specific associations between warble song notes and body movements in budgerigar courtship displays.**  
*Biology Open*.  
[DOI](https://doi.org/10.1242/bio.060497) | [First Person interview](https://journals.biologists.com/bio/article/13/10/bio061701/362431/First-person-Nakul-Wewhare)

This paper studies how vocal and body-movement elements align during budgerigar courtship and asks how consistent those associations are across individuals.
:::

::: {.publication-entry}
#### Madabhushi, A. J. J., Wewhare, N., Binwal, P., Agarwal, V., and Krishnan, A. (2023)

**Higher-order dialect variation and syntactic convergence in the complex warble song of budgerigars.**  
*Journal of Experimental Biology*, 226(20): jeb245678.  
[DOI](https://doi.org/10.1242/jeb.245678)

This study examines dialect variation and convergence in complex warble song, with attention to higher-order sequence structure.
:::

::: {.publication-entry}
#### Wewhare, N. and Pandey, U. (2021)

**First record of scavenging by a checkered keelback (*Fowlea piscator*) from Western Maharashtra, India.**  
*Reptiles & Amphibians*, 28(2), 348-349.  
[DOI](https://doi.org/10.17161/randa.v28i2.15638)
:::
